_readme: Settings for desk-clock. Push a change to the board with:
Every key is optional -- delete this file and the app runs on its compiled
defaults. Wi-Fi credentials are NOT here and must not be: they live in
lib/board/secrets.h, which is gitignored and compiled in, because this file
sits on a filesystem anyone holding the board can dump. See SECURITY.md.
Out-of-range values are rejected and named on the serial log, not silently
clamped, so a typo tells you about itself.
_timezone: POSIX TZ string. Also what the clock and the night window use.
_location: Weather location. lat -90..90, lon -180..180 -- both range-checked because
a swapped pair is the classic mistake and open-meteo answers 400 for it
rather than anything that reads like 'you swapped your coordinates'.
place is the header label, 12 glyphs max (the width of its box).
_brightness: OPTIONAL backlight override, 8-255. Omit either key and that level comes
from the active colour scheme instead -- the nine schemes each carry their
own day/night duty because the light one is unbearable at the dark one's
brightness, and a blanket override would throw that away.
Backlight is the one dial that measurably moves power on this board:
duty 140 measures 45.1C at the die, 100 is 43.5C, 60 is 40.5C, 0 is 37.1C.
_night: Hours (0-23) the night brightness applies. Wraps midnight.
_refresh: Minutes between weather fetches, 1-240. open-meteo is free; don't hammer it.
